definitions.explanation: A gate or barrier used to control the flow of water in rivers, canals, dams, or irrigation systems.

examples.japanese: {大雨|おおあめ}に{備|そな}えて{水門|すいもん}を{閉|し}めた。
examples.english: They closed the sluice gate in preparation for heavy rain.

examples.japanese: この{川|かわ}には{洪水|こうずい}を{防|ふせ}ぐための{水門|すいもん}がいくつも{設置|せっち}されている。
examples.english: Several floodgates have been installed along this river to prevent flooding.

notes: Composed of {水|すい} (water) + {門|もん} (gate). Japan's many rivers and flood-prone geography make {水門|すいもん} an important part of infrastructure. Often mentioned in news during typhoon season and heavy rain events. Common collocations: {水門|すいもん}を{開|あ}ける (to open a sluice gate), {水門|すいもん}を{閉|し}める (to close a sluice gate), {防潮|ぼうちょう}{水門|すいもん} (tidal floodgate).
